statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model_id=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.id'); short_model=$(echo "$model_id" | sed 's|.*claude-||' | rev | sed 's/-/./' | rev); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); project_root=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.project_dir'); branch=$(git -C "$cwd" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo "no-git"); tar_project=$(grep -m1 '^TAR_PROJECT=' "$project_root/.Renviron" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2); project_suffix=$([ -n "$tar_project" ] && echo " {$tar_project}" || echo ""); wt_marker=$([ "$cwd" = "$project_root" ] && echo "" || echo "*"); echo "$short_model [$branch$wt_marker]$project_suffix"
